explanation.read_label: This is a price-driven read more than a matchup edge.
explanation.attribution_note: Driver impacts are approximate probability-point contributions and do not sum to the edge.
explanation.prose: A 4.3pp gap: IBP has TEX at 47.4%, the market at 43.5%. The largest lift is defense (oaa) (~+0.6pp): TEX defense grades +23 OAA better on the season — a run-prevention edge. The main pushback is home field (~-1.1pp): TB's home-field context weighs against the pick playing on the road. With a headwind that size, this is not a clean all-signal read. The market has drifted against the pick since posting, widening the available price — the current +132 still sits inside the playable range (to +131). This is value in the number more than the matchup — the model just makes TEX a better side than the price does.
